summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend retest confirms the final /api/dashboards/docente/grupos-comparativa fix works: PRECBH2602000_20003 is no longer present and no returned group has EXT* or fuera-de-malla/extensión metadata. Historical, docente student history, executive, academic, and carrera/facultad filter calculations also match academic-only DB totals. However, the bug is still not comprehensively fixed across all tableros: /api/admin/grupos and /api/admin/grupos/{codigo_grupo} still return averages/notas for the Inglés Fuera de la Malla group PRECBH2602000_20003.

critical.issue: Still returns non-academic group programa='Inglés 3 (inglés Fuera de la Malla 2026-1 B2)' with promedio_historico=4.2 and notas_historico=3. This violates the user contract that outside-malla English must not be considered in notas/promedios across all dashboards.

Detail endpoint for the same outside-malla English group returns notas_por_periodo=[{'periodo':'2026-1','promedio':4.2,'total':3,'aprobadas':3,'tasa':100.0}], so the admin group detail tablero still shows a non-academic average.

integration_issues.issue: Backend still supplies non-academic promedio/notas for PRECBH2602000_20003, so any frontend consuming these admin endpoints will show outside-malla English averages.

action_items: Update /api/admin/grupos list enrichment to suppress promedio_historico/notas_historico when the group metadata itself is non-academic (programa/facultad outside-malla/extensión or EXT* assignment), not only when matching historico_notas rows are excluded.
Update /api/admin/grupos/{codigo_grupo} to return no notas_por_periodo/promedio for non-academic groups such as PRECBH2602000_20003.
Retest PRECBH2602000_20003 specifically in both admin group list and detail, plus the already-passing dashboard endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/admin_router.py lines ~246-268: list_grupos enriches every grupo, and the notes query filters historico_notas only. It does not first exclude/suppress groups whose own programa/facultad identify Inglés Fuera de la Malla/Extensión, so PRECBH2602000_20003 receives a 4.2 promedio from matching non-excluded note metadata.

/app/backend/routers/admin_router.py lines ~279-321: get_grupo_detail returns the outside-malla group and computes notas_por_periodo for it. The same group-level non-academic guard used in docente grupos-comparativa is missing here.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; used existing preview MongoDB iudigital data and superadmin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

rca_of_the_issue: The final fix correctly filters the docente grupos-comparativa group list with is_academic_note(), but the admin group endpoints still compute/display historical stats for non-academic group metadata. Reproduction: login as superadmin, GET /api/admin/grupos?codigo_grupo=PRECBH2602000_20003 and GET /api/admin/grupos/PRECBH2602000_20003; both return the Inglés Fuera de la Malla group with average 4.2.
